subject_lines: We've missed you — something special awaits
Your welcome back treat is ready
A new seasonal sip with your name on it
preheader: It's been a while. Something delicious just arrived that we think you'll love.
mjml:
<mjml>
  <mj-head>
    <mj-attributes>
      <mj-all font-family="Sodo Sans, Arial, sans-serif" />
      <mj-text font-size="16px" color="#333333" />
    </mj-attributes>
  </mj-head>
  <mj-body background-color="#FFFFFF">
    <!-- Hero Section -->
    <mj-section background-color="#00704A" padding="60px 20px">
      <mj-column>
        <mj-text font-size="32px" color="#FFFFFF" font-weight="bold" align="center" padding="0 0 15px 0">
          It's been a while, friend
        </mj-text>
        <mj-text font-size="16px" color="#FFFFFF" align="center" padding="0">
          We've saved your usual spot. And crafted something new you'll want to try.
        </mj-text>
      </mj-column>
    </mj-section>

    <!-- Gold Accent Band -->
    <mj-section background-color="#FFFFFF" padding="0">
      <mj-column>
        <mj-divider border-color="#CBA258" border-width="3px" width="80px" />
      </mj-column>
    </mj-section>

    <!-- Atmospheric Image Section -->
    <mj-section background-color="#FFFFFF" padding="30px 20px">
      <mj-column>
        <mj-image src="http://hailuo-image-algeng-data-us.oss-us-east-1.aliyuncs.com/image_inference_output%2Ftalkie%2Fprod%2Fimg%2F2026-04-09%2F74e3c7c5-95e9-498f-88a9-58dd02b0c6d6_aigc.jpeg?Expires=1775822904&OSSAccessKeyId=LTAI5tRDTcyEYLLuBEpJRwCi&Signature=aBeodRx1QVzW0kZGX1cK%2FL4Ziao%3D" alt="Cozy coffee moment with warm seasonal drink" width="500px" align="center" />
      </mj-column>
    </mj-section>

    <!-- Message Section -->
    <mj-section background-color="#FFFFFF" padding="20px 20px 30px">
      <mj-column>
        <mj-text font-size="28px" color="#00704A" font-weight="bold" align="center" padding="0 0 15px 0">
          The season's best is here
        </mj-text>
        <mj-text font-size="16px" color="#333333" align="center" padding="0 0 25px 0">
          Rich, warming, and made for moments like these. Come back and rediscover what you've been missing.
        </mj-text>
        <mj-button href="https://www.starbucks.com" background-color="#00704A" color="#FFFFFF" border-radius="30px" padding="15px 35px" font-size="16px" font-weight="bold" align="center">
          Try It Now
        </mj-button>
      </mj-column>
    </mj-section>

    <!-- Accent Band -->
    <mj-section background-color="#CBA258" padding="8px 20px">
      <mj-column>
        <mj-text font-size="14px" color="#FFFFFF" align="center" padding="0">
          Your next favorite cup awaits
        </mj-text>
      </mj-column>
    </mj-section>

    <!-- Footer -->
    <mj-section background-color="#FFFFFF" padding="30px 20px 40px">
      <mj-column>
        <mj-text font-size="12px" color="#999999" align="center" padding="0 0 5px 0">
          Starbucks
        </mj-text>
        <mj-text font-size="12px" color="#999999" align="center" padding="0">
          It starts with you
        </mj-text>
      </mj-column>
    </mj-section>
  </mj-body>
</mjml>
rationale: This re-engagement email opens with a warm, personal hero that acknowledges the customer's absence without being accusatory, using the primary green color to feel familiar and inviting. The narrow gold divider creates visual rhythm without overwhelming the design, while the atmospheric image builds desire for the seasonal drink. The CTA is placed prominently after the key message, with the gold accent band serving as a final gentle nudge before the minimal footer.
image_prompt: Warm autumn coffee shop scene with soft golden light streaming through windows, a ceramic mug of seasonal drink with wisps of steam rising, scattered autumn leaves on a wooden table, cozy and inviting atmosphere, shallow depth of field, editorial photography style
